business_problem: Michelin needed to modernize a mission-critical application that monitors global internal data flows because its on-premises cluster crashed during end-of-month billing spikes, required heavy manual maintenance, and could not be taken offline for migration.
solution_summary: Michelin migrated its mission-critical E2E flow-monitoring application from heavy on-premises MongoDB servers to MongoDB Atlas so it could survive end-of-month billing spikes without crashes or downtime. The application ingests and tracks integration messages from IBM MQ and Kafka, and the database team used a mirrored dual-run migration with the MongoDB Cloud Migration Factory to keep flows active while Atlas rebuilt data and indexes. Once live, Atlas Autoscaling on an M60 NVMe cluster absorbed the doubled month-end message volume automatically, while Atlas Search replaced a custom search implementation that had bloated the database and required 26 indexes. By collapsing monitoring, indexing, and storage onto managed Atlas services, Michelin reduced message sizes, simplified query tuning, and freed the team from patching servers and hand-managing cluster capacity.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Runs Michelin's E2E flow-monitoring database with managed scaling and zero-downtime cloud operations.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Replaces a custom search mechanism so the monitoring application can index and query messages more efficiently.

data_flow: Integration messages from IBM MQ and Kafka are mirrored into MongoDB Atlas during migration, indexed and queried through MongoDB Atlas Search, and then served to DevOps teams that replay integrations, inspect error states, and monitor global flow health during ordinary and peak billing periods.
business_outcome: Michelin eliminated peak-time crashes, cut total project costs by 30%, reduced message sizes by 70%, shrank required indexes from 26 to six, and gave its teams a managed platform that can keep scaling alongside global operations.
